"ENTERASYS NETWORKS INC.", "MADE IN USA", "9003012-03 REV: 0A" :is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. ''802.11a OFDM Super Rate'' is printed on the label of the card.
The FCC ID on the card (QBO-RBTBF) is incorrect. :The correct FCC ID is QXO-RBTBF.
This module appears to be used in the RBTRC-MZ. :This card uses two ''SkyCross'' antennas.
*[http://web.archive.org/web/20030220010558/http://www.resonext.com/pressreleases/14nov02.html ''Resonext press release'' regarding this device (via archive.org)] :Brand Name: Cabletron Systems :Model Number: RBTBF-AX - PC Card Type II - 54Mbps
